entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:1
segments:
Thine enemies; foreign nations who should make war upon the Israelites, or against whom God should call the Israelites to make war. 
 
Men should not go to war except when God requires it; and when he does, their dependence should be not on themselves or their fellow men, but on him; and their object not their own gratification or aggrandizement, but the promotion of his glory and the highest good of mankind.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:5
segments:
Dedicated it; by acknowledging the goodness of God in giving it, feasting on the bounties of his providence, and seeking his blessing. 
 
The Lord is disposed to gratify all the innocent and useful affections of men, and not to call them ot arduous, self-denying, and dangerous duties, except when his glory and their good require it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:7
segments: Betrothed a wife; engaged to marry her.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:8
segments: Return unto his house; to free the army from all who were unwilling to go into the battle.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:10
segments: Proclaim peace; propose terms of peace.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:11
segments: Peace, wherever it can consistently be maintained, is desired by God, and should be by all men.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:13
segments: Smite every male; this was directed by God as a punishment for their sins, and was designed so to weaken the nation that they would not be likely to make war upon the Israelites in future.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:16
segments: These people; the Canaanites, who were by God devoted to destruction, and whose land the Israelites were to possess.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:18
segments: As it is wicked to kill any human being unless God require it, so it is wicked to spare any whom he requires to be slain.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:19
segments:
Not destroy the trees; the fruit-trees. 
 
  The tree--is man's life; it's fruit is the means of his support.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 20:20
segments: Not trees for meat; not fruit-trees.
